systems.name: Gantry
notes: Ensure the crane has come to a complete standstill and gantry wheel clamps/chocks are secured before working on travel motors.
The four travel motors are interlinked — isolating one motor disables full gantry travel.

loads.name: Supply Gantry Motor 1
notes: Gantry Travel Motor 1 — Ensure crane is completely stationary before isolating.
All four travel motors are mechanically and electrically coupled via speed synchronization.

loads.name: Supply Gantry Motor 2
notes: Gantry Travel Motor 2 — Ensure crane is completely stationary before isolating.

loads.name: Supply Gantry Motor 3
notes: Gantry Travel Motor 3 — Ensure crane is completely stationary before isolating.

loads.name: Supply Gantry Motor 4
notes: Gantry Travel Motor 4 — Ensure crane is completely stationary before isolating.

loads.name: Gantry Lights — Corner 1 & 4
notes: Lighting for corners 1 & 4 — Ensure lighting control switch is off before opening breaker.

otherSources.label: Lighting Transformer
otherSources.description: Check F6 — Lighting transformer supply breaker in panel EH1.

loads.name: Gantry Lights — Corner 2 & 3
notes: Lighting for corners 2 & 3 — Ensure lighting control switch is off before opening breaker.

otherSources.label: Lighting Transformer
otherSources.description: Check F6 — Lighting transformer supply breaker in panel EH1.

loads.name: Lighting Transformer
notes: Main lighting transformer supply — Opening breaker de-energizes all floodlights and platform lighting.

loads.name: Control ON
notes: Main Crane Control Circuit Safety — Isolating disables all motion control and safety circuits.
Notify crane operator and ensure all systems are securely parked before isolating.

loads.name: Intercom System
notes: Cabin & ground intercom system — Establish alternative radio communications before isolating.

loads.name: Spreader Control Voltage
notes: Spreader control power — Stored capacitive energy in PLC/electronic cards.
Bleed residual pneumatic / hydraulic pressure on twistlock cylinder circuits after isolation.

otherSources.label: Main Control Circuit
otherSources.description: Check F11 in panel EH1 — Main Control ON.

systems.name: Trolley
notes: Ensure the trolley is completely stationary and rail storm locks/brakes are applied before servicing.
All four trolley motors are interlinked — isolating one disables trolley travel.

loads.name: Trolley Travelling Motor 1
notes: Trolley Travelling Motor 1 — Ensure trolley is at a complete standstill before isolating.

loads.name: Trolley Travelling Motor 2
notes: Trolley Travelling Motor 2 — Ensure trolley is at a complete standstill before isolating.

loads.name: Trolley Travelling Motor 3
notes: Trolley Travelling Motor 3 — Ensure trolley is at a complete standstill before isolating.

loads.name: Trolley Travelling Motor 4
notes: Trolley Travelling Motor 4 — Ensure trolley is at a complete standstill before isolating.

systems.name: Hoist
notes: Always lower spreader / suspended load fully to the ground before isolation — DANGER of suspended load drop.

loads.name: Hoist Working Brake
notes: Hoist Service/Working Brake — Lower load to the ground first. Suspended load will drop if brake release circuit is de-energized unexpectedly.
Control circuits may retain voltage from UPS; verify with a calibrated voltage meter.

otherSources.label: Control Voltage & UPS
otherSources.description: Check F11 and main PLC control UPS in panel EH1.

loads.name: Hoist Emergency Brake
notes: Hoist Emergency Caliper Brake — Verify drum is mechanically locked or load is fully grounded.
Stored mechanical energy in heavy spring thruster assembly — do not tamper with mechanics under tension.

loads.name: Blower Hoisting
notes: Hoisting motor forced-air cooling blower — Ensure fan has coasted to a complete stop before touching rotating parts.
Blower impeller blades can freewheel for several minutes after power isolation.

systems.name: Skew
notes: When isolating any skew motor, isolate both Q34 and Q35 together to prevent twisting or lateral frame stresses.

loads.name: Skew Motor 1
notes: Skew Motors 1 & 2 are mechanically paired across the structure — also isolate Q35 in panel TR.

loads.name: Skew Motor 2
notes: Skew Motors 1 & 2 are mechanically paired across the structure — also isolate Q34 in panel TRJ.

loads.name: Shift Motor
notes: Shift mechanism drive — Ensure mechanical traverse is at zero position and parked before locking out.

systems.name: Hydraulic
notes: WARNING: Hydraulic power pack retains high pressurized oil. Bleed hydraulic accumulator and zero pressure gauges before any maintenance.

loads.name: Hydraulic Pump E House
notes: E-House main hydraulic pump — Bleed accumulator and discharge stored fluid pressure completely before disassembly.
Verify all hydraulic isolation ball valves are locked in safe closed position.

otherSources.label: Auxiliary Heating & Sensors
otherSources.description: Check panel EH1 for oil sump heater and tank level monitoring feeds.

loads.name: Hydraulic Pump Diesel Side
notes: Diesel side hydraulic pump — Bleed accumulator pressure and verify 0 bar gauge reading.
Ensure diesel generator/engine is locked and tagged out to prevent accidental cranking.
